name: The English Pale Campground and Resort
note: Adults only: every guest must be 21 or older with ID (children only on whole-property rentals). Rustic sites on a wooded bluff above the Black River, with portable toilets; the property's river beach is a 10-15 minute walk by trail. Nudity is tolerated for sunbathing at sites and on the beach (not a nudist park). Some weekends the whole property is rented to a single group. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site englishpalewi.com + its Rules PDF (rev. 03/03/26) + Hipcamp listing (status LIVE, isBookable true, 54 of 55 reviews positive), read 2026-11-21: 5 rustic vehicle sites (B14, B16, B18, B20, B21), 50x50 ft with 60-ft gravel pads 'built to accommodate (RV's, 5th Wheels and travel trailers)' (Hipcamp rig max 50 ft; B14 38 ft combined), sold by the night on Hipcamp with a 1-night minimum (7 max) at $35.30 for 2 people + tax; Google Maps 'The English Pale Campground and Resort' 5.0 on 25 reviews, open, phone 715-299-7007 (gm.py 2026-11-21); no RV Life record (Algolia name query + 44.05-44.17N box). Private price gate passes ($35.30 < US$50); price + presence indicators both met (posted rate + working Hipcamp booking page; website with phone).
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-21: the RV sites (Hipcamp host pins for B14/B16/B18/B20/B21 at 44.1065-44.1077, -91.0206 to -91.0209) sit on the wooded bluff 'up top', about 70 ft above the river (Hipcamp text; Open-Meteo DEM 237 m vs ~215 m at the river). Esri imagery (sat.py 44.1071,-91.0195 half-width 450 m, rendered 900x900; and 44.1071,-91.0207 half-width 160 m, rendered) shows continuous woods there, with the Black River channel ~250 m to the south/southeast and no water visible from the pad area; the imagery predates the 2025 pads but can only veto. Operator: the beach is 'approximately a 10-15 minute walk' on trails. The only water near the pads is a small wetland slough ~65 m east through trees (well under 5 acres: pond-sized, no view value). The riverside/beach sites (R3-R6) are tent / walk-in or permit-road sites for overland trailers and 4x4 vans down a 14% grade, not RV sites, and earn nothing.
fees_source: englishpalewi.com Rules PDF (img1.wsimg.com/blobby/go/9bd35d52-9da3-4a37-af59-cea7b082106a/Rules%20030326.pdf, revised 03/03/26): 'Rustic Beach Sites, Rustic RV, 5th-Wheel, Travel Trailers, or Tent Camp Sites - Two (2) people = $35.30 per night, each additional person $3.00 to a maximum of 6 people = $47.30 plus tax and booking fees'; home page 'Rates are $35.30 night + taxes/fees'; Hipcamp listing pricePerNightBase $35.30 on every B site. Read 2026-11-21. (Card/PayPal payments made directly add 4%.)
sites_source: englishpalewi.com home page, read 2026-11-21: 'We have 5 Rustic (boondocking) camp sites (B14, B16, B18, B20 & B21) that are sized 50'X50'. Gravel pads (60') built to accommodate (RV's, 5th Wheels and travel trailers).' Count is the vehicle sites only; the property also has 6 rustic river/beach tent sites (R1-R6, several closed until 2027 for erosion-wall repair).
facilities_source: englishpalewi.com home page + Rules PDF (rev. 03/03/26) + Hipcamp listing, read 2026-11-21: 'our outdoor shower is located at the Water Station for use by all campers'; Hipcamp: 'Showers ... Hot water, Cold water', 'potable water is available', 'A Water Station and outdoor shower (hot/cold water) is provided on the north side of the Manor House'; Rules PDF 'Sewage Dump Station - Flying J Travel Center ... 18 miles north of campground' (none on the property). Toilets are portable ('a portable toilet is near by'), so flush/vault left unset.
hookups_source: englishpalewi.com home page, read 2026-11-21: 'No electric or water hookups are available'; Hipcamp listing: 'We have 5 rustic (no hook-ups) RV/Travel Trailer/Tent sites' and 'The Campground is rustic and does not provide electrical or water hook-ups currently.'
flags: Adults-only (21+, ID checked) and nudity-tolerant for sunbathing ('not a nudist campground. We do not encourage, nor do we prohibit nudity'); both are note lines under the rules, but AWH may want to judge whether the entry belongs in a family-facing database.
Closed for the 2026 season since Sep 24, 2026 ('CLOSING EARLY this year'); 2027 opening date not published, so no season group. Hipcamp says sites book 6 months ahead.
Whole-property 'takeover' weekends (group rentals) close the campground to individual bookings on some weekends; the operator posts a calendar PDF.

B16 also hosts the operator's rental travel trailer ('B16 Trailer 07 Sunset'), so only 4 bare RV sites may be free when it is rented. B14 is a curved pull-through around an oak, 38 ft combined ('Pulled units 21' or less are a good fit').

Ownership private, not hipcamp: Hipcamp is the only booking channel but the operator runs its own website with rates, rules and phone (curation doc: an operator with a genuine website of its own is private).
A 50/30-amp hookup beside the Manor House exists but only with a whole-property rental; not counted in hookups.

Pin is the centroid of the Hipcamp host pins for the five B sites; imagery predates the 2025 pads (all woods), so it could not be checked visually. Google/Hipcamp's property pin (44.1112,-91.0186) is at the WIS-54 frontage.
No duplicate: nothing in campgrounds.json within 8 km or by name (3524 Melrose City Park already dropped).
Price gate passed on rate alone, so gateways.py was not run.
